writeup: TIC 440828388 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 1.1351 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing a 4.04% dimming, with a detection significance of 165.7 in the Box Least Squares search. Pixel-level difference imaging confirmed the signal with a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 23.4, though the centroid offset of 3.8 arcsec from the target warrants attention in further study. No secondary eclipse was detected. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously uncatalogued system. The machine learning screening score of 0.32 reflects moderate confidence that this represents a real astrophysical target rather than an instrumental artifact.
